text:
jamie: Heads-up — we saw a tenant send a 1k-item embeddings batch with varied dims and it pegged the ingress queue for ~45s. Everything else slowed.
sophia: ugh. did it fail or just backpressure?
jamie: mostly backpressure, a few 413s from the splitter when it hit the per-payload byte cap. runtime traces show continuous batching held onto that request until it drained.
rahul: can you paste the orig request? like header + sample payload?
jamie: https://s3.redwood/incident/1830004321/logs.txt (redacted). header they set: `X-Embed-Dims: 768,512,768,1024,...` and no per-item size hints. client used gzip but still >8MB after framing.
console-pm: from console POV customers see an opaque 413. we need better UX: either show estimated "embed-units" before submit or suggest chunking.
sophia: Agreed. Two parts: runtime protection (bulk-shedding) and console guidance. For runtime I propose: detect multi-dim bulks above byte threshold -> mark as "shedding candidate" and fast-reject with a structured JSON pointing to help/docs + suggested split sizes.
rahul: fast-reject helps latency but breaks some clients expecting retries. maybe a soft-reject mode on canary where we return 202 + async accept?
jamie: 202 async is heavier operationally. soft-reject could be a 4xx with header `X-Embed-Suggest-Split: 100` and body with `suggested_chunk_dims` array. canary it behind `bulk_shed_v2` flag.
console-pm: i can add UI hint: when estimated units > soft threshold show a modal: "This request is large — recommended chunk size N; try client-side chunking or enable streaming embeddings." Link to SDK example.
sophia: telemetry: emit `bulk_shed.reason`, `orig_total_bytes`, `orig_max_dim`, and `suggested_chunks`. Also track percent of requests converted by SDK autop-chunk feature.
rahul: for rollout: start with metrics-only, then soft-reject canary for 5% tenants (opt-in), then default-on fast-reject with clear console messaging.
jamie: I'll open a runtime PR for detection + header, add unit tests for mixed-dim framing.
console-pm: I'll draft console copy and add a small banner in the Embeddings route page.
sophia: I'll wire the telemetry schema and add dashboards: one for bulk-shed rate by tenant, one for post-shed retry success.
k8s-bot: deploy triggered: infra/embeds-shed-detect v0.1 -> staging (sha: a1b2c3).
rahul: nice. once staging metrics look sane we can cut a canary. tagging @eng-oncall for potential SLO churn. :eyes:
